selectionReason: The issue #60 rule selects up to ten absent Joyo kanji in frozen source-row order, with one support-word article per selected kanji. A qualifying support word uses JMdict news1, ichi1, spec1, or gai1; news2/spec2 do not qualify. The selected rows 63, 67, 68, 72, 120, 123, 125, 126, 131, and 132 are the first ten remaining Joyo rows after B157. Every support word's other kanji already has a card. 升 is the sole priority-tag exception: no JMdict entry written with 升 carries a qualifying tag; 升 ます (1346290) carries only news2/spec2, and 升 しょう, 一升, 一升瓶, 升目 and the other 升 spellings are untagged. The exception is explicit and must receive row-specific independent review.

supportMappings.exceptionReason: No JMdict entry written with 升 carries news1, ichi1, spec1, or gai1 in the pinned snapshot; 升 ます (1346290) carries only news2/spec2, and every other 升 spelling is untagged. Keep this explicit exception for independent review.

mechanicalChecks.readingExtras: 偏 ひとえ.に, ふ.れる; 傍 ホウ, そば, はた, わき, そ.う, そい, かたえ; 債 か.り, か.し; 勲 いさお, いさおし; 匠 たくみ; 匿 ジョク, かく.れる, かくま.う, かく.す; 升 のぼ.る; 即 ショク, つ.く, すなわ.ち; 却 しりぞ.く, しりぞ.ける, かえ.って. Sources: the readings Kanjipedia marks as outside the official table (外); the Digital Daijisen character entries (匿 かくす) and the Daijisen headwords that list 傍 (そい, かたえ, はた) on the Weblio pages; and a JMdict okurigana scan of kanji-plus-kana headwords, skipping search-only forms (偏 ふれる from 偏れる in 1361350; 匿 かくす from 匿す in 1170650, a rarely used kanji form). The scan's へんする and そくする reuse the on readings, which are already excluded. reading_exposure.py also reads the JMdict single-kanji entries itself (for example 偏 かたほ, JMdict 2854582, and 傍 かたがた, JMdict 1590370); no other card offers those.

Neither reading can be drawn: the curated Starter options of 傍 (赤 午 金) and 即 (母 白 天) fill every wrong slot in every audited pool, so the fallback is never consulted, as reading_exposure.py confirms.
